chunks: We were indeed gracious to Moses and Aaron,
ai.seo_question: What divine favor was bestowed upon Moses and Aaron in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saffat, this verse underscores the unique divine favor (manan) granted to Musa and Harun, emphasizing their role as key figures in the narrative of prophethood and deliverance. Shia scholarship often highlights this pairing to illustrate the complementary nature of leadership and spiritual authority, reflecting the broader theme of divine selection and guidance throughout Islamic history.
